subject: NovaRetail: token economics & SLO-driven config — next steps
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@novaretail.com>, devops@novaretail.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-20T16:12:00Z
Subject: NovaRetail discovery recap — token volumes & initial econ questions

Tara / team — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and the asks we agreed on so we can align next steps.

Recap of what you shared
- Current steady-state: ~8–12M tokens/day for search/autocomplete (latency-sensitive)
- Peak/spike patterns: hourly spikes up to ~25M tokens/day during promotions
- Projected scale: 200–300M tokens/mo within 6–9 months as more services onboard
- Primary SLOs: search endpoints need tight latency (p50 ~100–150ms, p95 target <=400ms). Background generation can tolerate higher latencies.

Budget / unit-econ ask
- You mentioned a target in the range of $50–$70 / 1M tokens during the call — can you confirm a firm target or budget band for a pilot?
- Also confirm whether a 6–12 month committed reservation is possible (reduces unit cost significantly).

Trade-offs we flagged (high level)
- Streaming (low per-token batching) → best for p50/p95 latency but ~20–40% higher per-token cost vs aggressive batching.
- Batching (longer batch windows) → best per-token cost; adds tail latency (p95) impact during spikes.
- Dedicated reserved capacity → predictable unit economics and capacity for spikes; hosted (on-demand) is faster to start but has higher unit cost for sustained volumes.

Attachments: I attached a short mutual action plan template (NovaRetail_MAPlan.xlsx) we can fill in together.

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Confirm target $/1M tokens (pilot) or a budget band we should aim for.
2) Confirm whether you prefer to start hosted or want us to size a short Dedicated pilot.
3) Share a short traffic profile (hourly qps distribution) if you can — that helps us recommend batching windows and a multipath routing mix.

I'll draft 2 quick pricing scenarios (streaming-focused and batching-focused) once you confirm the budget band.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

From: Tara Singh <tara.singh@novaretail.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: devops@novaretail.com
Date: 2027-02-21T09:22:00Z
Subject: Re: NovaRetail discovery recap — token volumes & initial econ questions

Thanks, Mina — good recap. A few clarifications from our side:

Volumes (clarified)
- Baseline: ~10M tokens/day across search + personalization; spikes up to 25M tokens/day (short windows).
- Monthly: current ~300M tokens/mo; expect growth to 650–800M/mo in 6–9 months depending on rollout cadence.

Budget / target unit econ
- For a pilot we are targeting $60 / 1M tokens (ballpark). If a committed Dedicated option can get us below $45 / 1M that becomes compelling.

Latency SLOs
- Search: p50 target ~120ms, p95 <= 350–400ms (hard cap).
- Personalization: p95 <= 600ms acceptable.

Deployment preference
- Prefer hosted for speed of onboarding but are open to Dedicated if economics and SLOs require it.

Attached is a short hourly traffic dump (internal link) — it shows the promotional spikes. Let me know if you need a different format.

Tara Singh
Head of ML Infrastructure | NovaRetail
tara.singh@novaretail.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@novaretail.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-22T18:45:00Z
Subject: Pricing scenarios for NovaRetail — pilot options + quick cost model

Tara — following Mina's notes, I ran two compact scenarios using your stated targets. Quick summary (ballpark per-1M token costs):

Scenario A — Hosted, mixed routing (start fast)
- Streaming-first for search endpoints; batching for background jobs.
- Estimated blended cost: ~$58 / 1M tokens at your current profile (includes 20–25% premium for streaming on search).
- Pros: fastest time-to-value, no infra commit; Cons: less predictable in huge spikes, higher unit cost for sustained load.

Scenario B — Dedicated reserved capacity (6–12 mo commit)
- Dedicated pool sized for 95th-percentile sustained traffic with autoscale headroom for short spikes. Use streaming for search + prewarmed instances for fast tails.
- Estimated blended cost: ~$40–$47 / 1M tokens depending on commit level and quantization profile.
- Pros: lowest unit cost and predictable performance; Cons: procurement lead time and commit required.

Key tradeoffs and knobs
- Streaming vs batching: streaming adds ~20–40% cost but preserves p95; batching savings compound at high volume (best for background pipelines).
- Quantization / model variant: switch to int8/quantized variants for non-critical endpoints → 10–15% cost reduction with small quality delta.
- Multipath routing (e.g., route 70% of traffic to cheaper variant, 30% to high-performance variant) can hit both $/1M and SLO targets for mixed workloads.

Attached: nova_cost_model_v1.csv (simple estimator) and I added a HubSpot link with our deal record: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/NR-2027-57

Can we get 30 minutes next week for a short tech + pricing run-through? Mina / Rishi can walk the traffic profile and recommend specific batch windows and Dedicated sizing.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@novaretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-23T09:08:00Z
Subject: Re: NovaRetail discovery recap — token economics & pilot recommendation

Tara — based on your target ($60 / 1M pilot) and the traffic profile you shared, here is a short SLO-driven pilot recommendation and the next steps I suggest.

Pilot proposal (30 days) — mixed routing Dedicated-lite
- Setup: Dedicated pool sized to handle 95th percentile baseline + autoscale for short spikes. Host two routing classes:
  - Low-latency search route: streaming path, high-performance model variant, prewarmed instances (p50 aim ~120ms, p95 <= 350–400ms).
  - Cost-optimized background route: batching path, quantized model variant for other jobs.
- Expected blended unit cost (pilot): targeting ~$50–62 / 1M tokens depending on the % of traffic on the streaming path. With multipath routing we can tune to your $60 pilot target quickly.
- Observability: we'll enable token-level cost breakdown + percentile latency dashboards in Redwood Console and surface any quality regressions against your eval prompts.

Operational comments
- Autoscaling & burst capacity: we'll configure short-lived burst workers for promotional spikes to avoid p95 violations without oversizing baseline.
- Guardrails: automatic fallback to a cheaper variant if Dedicated headroom is exhausted (to avoid OOMs).

Action items / next steps
1) Tara — confirm pilot budget band (you said $60 target; confirm if $50–$65 is acceptable for a pilot).
2) If accepted, Marissa will generate a short SOW/quote (we suggest a month-to-month pilot SOW to start).
3) Tara / devops — please share the final CSV of hourly QPS distribution and any blacklisted IPs or security constraints for onboarding.
4) Book a technical run-through (suggested participants: Mina, Rishi, your ML infra lead) — Marissa can propose times.

If you confirm the pilot budget band today I can have a pilot configuration and expected cost breakdown ready by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks again —
Mina Haddad
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
